hints: You are asked the same question after every reading. What is the smallest amount of the stream you could keep and still answer it?
The `k` largest readings so far - and of those, only the smallest one is ever the answer.
A min-heap holding exactly `k` readings. Its root is the answer; a new reading either beats the root and replaces it, or is dropped forever.
Sorting after every reading is correct and costs O(n log n) per call. The heap costs O(log k), and nothing about it grows as the stream does.
